authority_status_zh: 提议接口，权责与授权尚未核实
authority_status_en: Proposed interfaces; authority and mandate are not verified
design_boundary_zh: 本矩阵只提出可供专业团队继续核验的区域交换接口，不记录既有合作、协议、容量、资金、部署或绩效。
design_boundary_en: This matrix proposes regional exchange interfaces for further professional verification; it records no existing partnership, agreement, capacity, funding, deployment, or performance.

allowed_generic_roles.label_zh: 公共空间或资产管护人
无障碍与公共利益审查人

resource_mechanisms.authority_status_zh: 不构成土地权属或供地判断，待授权核验
resource_mechanisms.authority_status_en: No tenure or land-supply determination; authorization must be verified

exchange_unit.unit_zh: 经授权的土地信息问题单与约束清单
exchange_unit.unit_en: An authorized land-information question and constraint record

entry_gate.zh: 只有在权属、规划、遗产、公共利益和授权边界被核实后，才可交换去身份化的约束信息；不交换地块承诺。
entry_gate.en: Exchange only de-identified constraint information after tenure, planning, heritage, public-interest, and authorization boundaries are verified; do not exchange parcel commitments.

stop_or_exit.zh: 权属或规划资料不能清权、出现冲突或授权撤回时，停止交换并保留问题单，不形成空间结论。
stop_or_exit.en: Stop the exchange and retain only the question record when tenure or planning material is uncleared, conflicting, or withdrawn; do not form a spatial conclusion.

resource_mechanisms.authority_status_zh: 不构成场地开放或使用许可，待资产管护与授权核验
resource_mechanisms.authority_status_en: No access or use permission; asset stewardship and authorization must be verified

exchange_unit.unit_zh: 可逆空间使用请求、静态替代和人工服务说明
exchange_unit.unit_en: A reversible space-use request with static alternatives and staffed-service notes

entry_gate.zh: 核实资产管护、合法通行、无障碍、消防安全、遗产与活动许可后，才可讨论既有空间中的可逆接口。
entry_gate.en: Discuss a reversible interface in existing space only after asset stewardship, lawful access, accessibility, fire safety, heritage, and event permissions are verified.

resource_mechanisms.accountable_generic_role_label_zh: 公共空间或资产管护人

stop_or_exit.zh: 无授权、无等效人工或静态路径、通行不安全或维护责任缺失时，停止空间接口并撤回可移动组件。
stop_or_exit.en: Stop the space interface and remove movable components when authorization, an equivalent staffed or static path, safe access, or maintenance responsibility is missing.

resource_mechanisms.authority_status_zh: 不记录企业名单、招商或产业绩效，待清权与授权核验
resource_mechanisms.authority_status_en: No company list, attraction, or industry performance is recorded; rights and authorization must be verified

exchange_unit.unit_zh: 方法说明、沙盒场景卡和可复核问题清单
exchange_unit.unit_en: A method note, sandbox scenario card, and reviewable question list

entry_gate.zh: 只接收清权、非敏感且用途相称的方法材料；任何企业身份、商业秘密、采购或招商安排均须另行授权。
entry_gate.en: Accept only cleared, non-sensitive, fit-for-purpose method material; company identity, trade secrets, procurement, and attraction arrangements require separate authorization.

stop_or_exit.zh: 来源、权利、用途或公共利益不能确认时，拒收或撤下材料，不把方法交流写成合作或产业承诺。
stop_or_exit.en: Reject or withdraw material when provenance, rights, use, or public interest cannot be confirmed; do not describe method exchange as partnership or industry commitment.

resource_mechanisms.authority_status_zh: 不构成资金来源、预算或拨付承诺，待授权核验
resource_mechanisms.authority_status_en: No funding source, budget, or disbursement commitment; authorization must be verified

exchange_unit.unit_zh: 资源问题单、成本类别和授权决策记录
exchange_unit.unit_en: A resource question, cost category, and authorization decision record

entry_gate.zh: 只有明确授权人、用途边界、公开合规和退出条件后，才可记录资金问题；不写金额或来源推断。
entry_gate.en: Record a funding question only after the authorizer, use boundary, public compliance, and exit condition are explicit; do not infer an amount or source.

stop_or_exit.zh: 授权缺失、用途变化或退出条件未满足时，停止资金接口讨论并删除未授权的筹措表述。
stop_or_exit.en: Stop discussing the funding interface and remove unauthorized fundraising language when authorization is missing, use changes, or exit conditions are unmet.

resource_mechanisms.authority_status_zh: 不记录招募、编制或服务保证，待授权核验
resource_mechanisms.authority_status_en: No recruitment, staffing, or service guarantee is recorded; authorization must be verified

exchange_unit.unit_zh: 审查能力请求、贡献记录和可退出的共学任务
exchange_unit.unit_en: A review-capacity request, contribution record, and exitable learning task

entry_gate.zh: 仅在自愿参与、角色边界、版权、隐私、无障碍和人工复核责任明确后，才可提出能力交换。
entry_gate.en: Propose capacity exchange only after voluntary participation, role boundaries, rights, privacy, accessibility, and human-review responsibility are explicit.

stop_or_exit.zh: 参与者撤回、角色不清、负担不对等或无法人工复核时，停止任务并保留最小贡献记录。
stop_or_exit.en: Stop the task and retain only a minimal contribution record when a participant withdraws, roles are unclear, burden is inequitable, or human review is unavailable.

resource_mechanisms.authority_status_zh: 不构成算力供给、平台接入或部署承诺，待授权核验
resource_mechanisms.authority_status_en: No compute supply, platform access, or deployment commitment; authorization must be verified

exchange_unit.unit_zh: 隔离沙盒的计算请求、版本和复现记录
exchange_unit.unit_en: An isolated-sandbox compute request with version and reproducibility record

entry_gate.zh: 只允许清权或合成输入、隔离环境、可追溯版本和人工失败审查；不接入公共服务或生产系统。
entry_gate.en: Allow only cleared or synthetic inputs, an isolated environment, traceable versions, and human failure review; do not connect to public service or production systems.

stop_or_exit.zh: 输入权利、隔离、复现或安全条件失效时，停止运行并保留可审计的退出记录。
stop_or_exit.en: Stop the run and retain an auditable exit record when input rights, isolation, reproducibility, or safety conditions fail.

resource_mechanisms.authority_status_zh: 不记录未清权数据或个人数据，待来源、许可和用途核验
resource_mechanisms.authority_status_en: No uncleared or personal data is recorded; provenance, license, and use must be verified

exchange_unit.unit_zh: 数据元数据、来源链、许可记录和不确定性说明
exchange_unit.unit_en: Data metadata, provenance chain, license record, and uncertainty note

entry_gate.zh: 核验来源权威性、时空范围、采集方法、许可、转换和用途；个人、敏感或未清权数据不得进入接口。
entry_gate.en: Verify authority, time-space coverage, collection method, license, transformation, and use; personal, sensitive, or uncleared data must not enter the interface.

stop_or_exit.zh: 来源、许可、用途或删除要求出现问题时，停止使用、撤回公开层并按授权规则处理记录。
stop_or_exit.en: Stop use, withdraw the public layer, and handle records under the authorization rules when provenance, license, use, or deletion requirements fail.

resource_mechanisms.authority_status_zh: 不构成场景开放、采购或运行承诺，待空间、数据与人工责任核验
resource_mechanisms.authority_status_en: No scenario opening, procurement, or operation commitment; space, data, and human responsibility must be verified

exchange_unit.unit_zh: 场景卡、人工复核记录、静态替代和退出条件
exchange_unit.unit_en: A scenario card, human-review record, static alternative, and exit condition

entry_gate.zh: 在空间与数据权利、无障碍、安全、人工闸、投诉和退出路径明确前，只保留概念讨论或隔离沙盒。
entry_gate.en: Keep the work at concept discussion or isolated-sandbox level until space and data rights, accessibility, safety, human gate, complaint, and exit paths are explicit.

stop_or_exit.zh: 任一硬门槛失效、投诉未处理、维护缺位或人工路径不可用时，停用候选输出并恢复静态或人工服务。
stop_or_exit.en: Disable candidate output and restore the static or staffed service when any hard gate fails, a complaint is unresolved, maintenance is absent, or a human path is unavailable.

proposed_exchange_capability.zh: 提议交换可理解的铁路叙事、公共服务测试反馈和社区共学问题；不记录既有合作或参与规模。
proposed_exchange_capability.en: Propose exchanging legible railway narratives, public-service test feedback, and community-learning questions; record no existing partnership or participation scale.

interface.zh: 以 AI 原点社区共译场的开放工作台、双语静态导览、纸质路径和人工说明作为候选接口。
interface.en: Use the AI Origin Community Civic Translation Field's open worktable, bilingual static guide, paper routes, and staffed explanation as candidate interfaces.

trigger_conditions.zh: 仅在授权联系人、社区自愿参与、无障碍、数据权利、史料核读和人工退出路径均被确认后触发。
trigger_conditions.en: Trigger only after an authorized contact, voluntary community participation, accessibility, data rights, reviewed historical material, and a staffed exit path are confirmed.

responsibility_boundary.zh: 本方案只提供可审计的概念材料；参与者保留独立选择、质疑和退出权，不形成代表社区的承诺。
responsibility_boundary.en: The proposal supplies auditable concept material only; participants retain independent choice, challenge, and exit rights, and no community commitment is formed.

proposed_exchange_capability.zh: 提议交换校准、模型卡、误差解释和场景评估方法；不记录机构合作、科研成果或资源供给事实。
proposed_exchange_capability.en: Propose exchanging calibration, model cards, error explanations, and scenario-evaluation methods; record no institutional partnership, research result, or resource-supply fact.

interface.zh: 以众智园校准场和中关村科技服务翼的隔离沙盒、方法说明与公共解释作为候选接口。
interface.en: Use the Zhongzhiyuan Calibration Field and Zhongguancun Technology Services Wing's isolated sandbox, method notes, and public explanation as candidate interfaces.

trigger_conditions.zh: 仅在资料来源与许可、沙盒隔离、专业审查、隐私边界和授权联系人均被确认后触发。
trigger_conditions.en: Trigger only after provenance and licenses, sandbox isolation, professional review, privacy boundaries, and an authorized contact are confirmed.

responsibility_boundary.zh: 本方案不代表未来科学城的参与、技术采用或成果认可；交换只限经授权的方法材料，公共发布仍需本地人工判断。
responsibility_boundary.en: The proposal does not represent participation, technology adoption, or recognition by Future Science City; exchange is limited to authorized method material and local human judgment remains required for public release.

proposed_exchange_capability.zh: 提议交换研究方法、数据来源说明、隔离试验和公共利益审查问题；不记录科研合作或设备、算力供给。
proposed_exchange_capability.en: Propose exchanging research methods, data-provenance notes, isolated tests, and public-interest review questions; record no research partnership or equipment or compute supply.

interface.zh: 以版本化实验记录、清权数据元数据和独立安全审查作为候选接口。
interface.en: Use versioned experiment records, cleared-data metadata, and independent safety review as candidate interfaces.

trigger_conditions.zh: 仅在输入清权、实验不连接公共服务、失败标准和人工退出机制均被确认后触发。
trigger_conditions.en: Trigger only after input rights, no connection to public service, failure criteria, and a staffed exit mechanism are confirmed.

responsibility_boundary.zh: 本方案只提出可比对的方法接口；任何研究结论、场地部署或跨区域责任均不由本矩阵代为确认。
responsibility_boundary.en: This matrix proposes comparable method interfaces only; it does not confirm research conclusions, site deployment, or cross-regional responsibility.

proposed_exchange_capability.zh: 提议交换场景可用性、运营回退、投诉闭环和公共接口评估方法；不记录招商、采购、企业名单或绩效。
proposed_exchange_capability.en: Propose exchanging methods for scenario usability, operational fallback, complaint handling, and public-interface evaluation; record no attraction, procurement, company list, or performance.

interface.zh: 以大钟寺转化场的终端可用性候选试验、静态服务和反馈记录作为候选接口。
interface.en: Use the Dazhongsi Adoption Field's candidate terminal-usability trial, static service, and feedback record as candidate interfaces.

trigger_conditions.zh: 仅在既有空间使用授权、消费者权益、无障碍、消防与机电专业审查、人工值守和等效非 AI 路径均被确认后触发。
trigger_conditions.en: Trigger only after existing-space authorization, consumer rights, accessibility, fire and mechanical review, staffed duty, and an equivalent non-AI path are confirmed.

responsibility_boundary.zh: 本方案不代表经开区的采用、产业转化或政策安排；现场安全、商业和服务决定必须由被授权的人类责任人作出。
responsibility_boundary.en: The proposal does not represent adoption, industrial conversion, or policy arrangements by the development area; on-site safety, commercial, and service decisions must be made by an authorized human owner.

proposed_exchange_capability.zh: 提议交换可复用的来源登记、场景卡、审查问题和退出模板；不记录跨区域合作、数据共享、资金或治理安排。
proposed_exchange_capability.en: Propose exchanging reusable provenance records, scenario cards, review questions, and exit templates; record no cross-regional partnership, data sharing, funding, or governance arrangement.

interface.zh: 以双语公共知识条目、版本日志和开放挑战问题集作为候选接口，不建立新的空间或行政边界。
interface.en: Use bilingual public-knowledge entries, version logs, and open-challenge question sets as candidate interfaces without establishing a new spatial or administrative boundary.

trigger_conditions.zh: 仅在各地权责、许可、数据跨域限制、版权、人工审查和撤回机制分别获得确认后触发。
trigger_conditions.en: Trigger only after each locality separately confirms authority, licenses, cross-jurisdiction data limits, rights, human review, and withdrawal mechanisms.

responsibility_boundary.zh: 本方案只提供可供比较的概念模板；不代替任何区域的审批、运营、数据交换或公共承诺。
responsibility_boundary.en: The proposal supplies comparable concept templates only; it does not replace any region's approval, operation, data exchange, or public commitment.
